dogecoin.text: Updating #dogecoin was not a smart move! It doesn't solve anything real and makes it seem like they try to be something else than the joke it is. It's an old fork of litecoin. Come on. An update just makes it boring. Not even @elonmusk could find that move to be anything but lame
I'm not saying I'm glad that $doge went down -36% in a day... but I am. And $eth is pumping and $bnb is slow and boring. The market is making more sense to me now.

Hope we are over 40k on friday and that all weak hands are shaken off. That people have learned that $doge is crap, that @elonmusk is just another rich son of a bitch. Then we can focus on great tech that will make the world better again.

@coinbase Congrats of adding this overblown piece of shit after everyone else. Also destroying my belief that even if you are slow and expensive - you at least don't add every shitty coin out there. You are also being part of destroying crypto space by normalize $doge.
